name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-koopalings
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Koopalings
description:
Alternative SMW Redrawn-styled Koopalings I always wanted to give them an appearance more similar to the artwork from Super Mario Bros 3 and Super Mario World and also fix some things like Larry not having a jaw, Lemmy and Wendy being larger than the others and Roy was also very strange in sideview graphic, this should fix all these problems.
This is also compatible with the Morton and Roy fireball patch since I took the time to redrawn those frames as well.
